description: Turns a generator function with one `yield` into a context manager factory: setup before the `yield`, teardown after it.
An exception raised in the `with` block is re-raised inside the generator at the `yield` line, so teardown belongs in `finally`.
A generator that catches the thrown-in exception and finishes tells `with` the error was handled.
A private `object()` that marks "no value", distinct from `None`, used to tell an absent key from a key holding `None`.
Base class that lets a context manager wrap every call of a function when used with `@`; `@contextmanager` managers have it.
